description: This file implements fuzzy sequence matching functions for the apply_patch tool, including Unicode normalization and multi-pass pattern matching strategies.

methods.name: normalizeUnicode
methods.description: Normalizes common Unicode punctuation and space characters to ASCII equivalents.

methods.name: exactMatch
methods.description: Checks if two arrays of lines match exactly.

methods.name: trimEndMatch
methods.description: Checks if two arrays of lines match after trimming trailing whitespace.

methods.name: trimMatch
methods.description: Checks if two arrays of lines match after trimming both sides.

methods.name: normalizedMatch
methods.description: Checks if two arrays of lines match after Unicode normalization.

methods.name: seekSequence
methods.description: Attempts to find a pattern sequence within lines with decreasing strictness, returning the start index or null.
